_about: Expected outcome of reproduce/laptop/run_experiment_v2.py --preset dissertation on a Snapdragon X Plus (X1P42100) laptop with a 120 Hz display. Values come from re-analysing the dissertation's own raw data (dissertation_reanalysis.json). Hardware timing never repeats exactly, so each value has a tolerance; the conclusion (NPU equivalent to baseline within 1%) is the part that must reproduce.

throughput._note: Absolute throughput depends on the display refresh rate, driver and browser version; it is only checked when the shader load and canvas match the dissertation.

cpu.dissertation_ci90: 0.9984-1.0119 (inconclusive with 3 runs; 10 runs may settle it either way)
